description: This file defines the ProjectModel class, which represents a data model for project entities within the Time API module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization and normalization features for project data, including properties like id, name, description, and deletion status.

classes.name: ProjectModel
classes.description: A data model class used for normalizing and serializing project data in the Time API, implementing the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the model with a Project entity, configuring filters and attribute mappings.
